summary: Iteration 27 (Invoice Service Date field + AI Code Assistant inside invoice screen) verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration27_test.py — owner login + client create; POST /api/invoices with service_date='2026-01-05' stores + returns it (GET confirms); POST /api/invoices WITHOUT service_date defaults to issue_date ('2026-01-08' -> service_date='2026-01-08'); PUT /api/invoices/{id} with service_date='2026-01-12' updates + GET confirms; PUT /api/invoices/{id} WITHOUT service_date in payload PRESERVES the existing '2026-01-12' (does NOT blank it — verified via `if not update.get('service_date')` branch at server.py:2260); GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf extracted via pypdf contains 'Service date' label AND '12/01/2026' formatted date, alongside existing 'Issued'/'Due'/'Status' lines (regression); POST /api/invoices/{id}/duplicate resets service_date to today (2026-07-07) even when source has 2026-01-12; POST /api/ai/ndis-assistant regression returns {answer:str, codes:[{code,name,rate,unit}, ...]} for 'personal care weekday evening' query (returned real suggestions from GPT-4o via Emergent LLM); light regression on save-as-draft then send via PUT still works. Frontend (390x800, owner TEST_USER_EMAIL, onboarding-skip tapped): (1) Invoices tab -> new-invoice-btn opened New Invoice screen. (2) 'Service Date (day work was performed)' label renders ABOVE Issue Date/Due Date row (service-date-input Y=... in DOM order before issue-date-input & due-date-input row) — defaulted to today 07/07/2026 ✓ (visible in screenshot). (3) Compliance panel 'Compliance 2/7 — complete the red items' includes 'Service date (day work was performed)' check with GREEN dot when service date is set, alongside 'Issue date' green — matches spec check-service-ok testID. (4) Tap 'Select NDIS support item' (ndis-code-btn-0-0) opens code picker sheet with a NEW **'Ask AI Code Assistant'** button (sparkles icon left, chevron right) rendered ABOVE the search bar — verified positions: AI btn top=228px, code-search top=284px (56px above search) ✓. (5) Tap open-ai-assistant-btn -> full-height 'NDIS Code Assistant' chat sheet opens (height 80%) with the intro bot message 'Hi! Describe what support you provided...' (ai-msg-0 visible, matches i18n aiIntro). (6) Typed '2 hours personal care weekday evening' in ai-input, tapped ai-send-btn — after ~5s the assistant replied with an answer '01_015_0107_1_1 | Assistance With Self-Care Activities - Standard - Weekday Evening. This is for personal care on a weekday evening.' and 1 tap-able code chip '01_015_0107_1_1 — $74.44' (ai-code-01_015_0107_1_1) ✓. (7) Tapped the suggested code chip — modal closed (ai-input count 0), Line Items 'Item 1' updated to code '01_015_0107_1_1', description auto-filled 'Assistance With Self-Care Activities - Standard - Weekday Evening', rate 74.44 ✓ (screenshot step_43). (8) Toast 'Applied {code}' — the code uses confirm() which on web is window.confirm; a dialog handler auto-accepted it (spec item met — code applied + user confirmation delivered). NOTE: I could not directly type into DateInput via .fill on its child input to explicitly test the save+reopen+edit-prefill path in-UI because DateInput is a masked-mask TextInput without a plain <input> descendant on web — but the underlying backend behaviour (service_date persists across GET, PUT preserves it if unsent, PUT updates it if sent, duplicate resets to today, PDF renders it) is fully green in pytest, and frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:133 reads `setServiceDate(inv.service_date || inv.issue_date || today)` on load — so the Edit-prefill wiring is correct by code review. i18n keys invoiceNew.serviceDate/aiTitle/askAi/aiIntro/aiInputPlaceholder/aiApplied/checkService all confirmed in en.json and rendered correctly in the UI. Console: only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*', 'props.pointerEvents') + expo-notifications-web + a burst of 401s BEFORE login (pre-auth API calls — expected). No red-screen errors, no unhandled promise rejections.

action_items: No blocking issues — the Service Date + AI Code Assistant features ship as-is.

OPTIONAL: DateInput on web uses a masked TextInput without a plain <input> child, so Playwright's .fill() on 'service-date-input input' times out. Consider adding a nested testID or a data-testid on the underlying input element in DateInput so headless UI tests can drive the value directly (currently readable via typing into the outer container works only if the mask supports keystroke buffering — inconsistent).
OPTIONAL (carry-over): migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:742 create_invoice correctly seeds service_date with `payload.service_date or payload.issue_date or now_iso()[:10]` — three-tier fallback prevents empty service_date when clients omit it.

server.py:2258-2261 edit_invoice guards against blanking: `if not update.get('service_date'): update['service_date'] = existing.get('service_date') or existing.get('issue_date','') or update.get('issue_date','')`. This is the key regression-safety line for the spec requirement 'PUT without service_date preserves existing' — verified by TestInvoiceServiceDate.test_update_invoice_without_service_date_preserves_existing.
server.py:2280 duplicate_invoice explicitly resets service_date = now_iso()[:10] (today) — matches spec, prevents accidentally carrying old service dates when cloning a template invoice.
server.py:1532 _build_invoice_pdf uses `_dmy(inv.get('service_date') or inv.get('issue_date',''))` — falls back to issue_date when service_date is empty (older invoices are safe).
server.py:447-501 /api/ai/ndis-assistant unchanged this iteration — regression test passes; codes returned in stable shape.

frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:58 serviceDate defaults `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` — matches backend default. line 133 loads `inv.service_date || inv.issue_date || today` on Edit — Edit-prefill logic correct.

frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:215 compliance rule `{ key: 'service', ok: !!serviceDate }` is included in the 7-point check — matches 2/7 count shown in the UI screenshot when only serviceDate+issueDate are set.
frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:486-488 open-ai-assistant-btn testID + sparkles icon + i18n askAi label — correctly placed above code-search input.
frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:115-122 applyAiCode closes modal, sets line item {ndis_code, description, rate}, dispatches confirm() toast — matches spec exactly.
